mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 54 degrees, feeling like 50 degrees. The Waning Crescent moon is visible tonight, and you can expect an overnight low of 49 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The city has released guidance regarding residential detached garages and sheds, and residents are reminded that curbside leaf collection runs from October through December. Please remember to keep leaves out of the street and behind the curb to ensure our vacuum trucks can operate effectively.

There is plenty to do in Verona this week. Starting with yoga today at Insight Wellness, you can also look forward to trivia nights at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, and the downtown farmer's market coming up on October 7.

In a noteworthy update, on October 3, Verona officers arrested a 19-year-old man who was found driving with an expired registration; he was carrying a stolen firearm and was also wanted on a probation warrant.

Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Chocolate Caramel Twist. The store is currently open, but please note that it will be closing soon in 47 minutes, so be sure to head over before 10:00 PM tonight.
